name: Quanta Storage Inc.
summary: Quanta Storage Inc. researches, develops, produces, manufactures, and sells data storage and processing equipment, electronic components, optical instruments, and industrial robots. It operates in three segments: The Mainland China Operation Center, The Southeast Asia Operation Center, and The Taiwan Operation Center. The company offers external storage products comprising NAS, phone pSSD, and portable SSD, as well as µCloud, a software system for mobile data storage solutions; and solid state drive products, such as DS2, U.2 PCIe Gen 4x4, M.2 PCIe Gen 4x4, M.2 PCIe Gen 3x4, M.2 SATA III, and 2.5 SATA III products.
